## Flat-Rate Pricing Guide (Transparent Upfront Estimates)

Here Handyman prices work using transparent flat rates per project rather than open-ended hourly meters, so customers know the exact price before work begins. Estimates are 100% free with zero obligation.

| Service Category | Typical Flat-Rate Range | Scope Included |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TV Wall Mounting** | \$150 – \$225 | Mount bracket into studs/masonry, level TV (up to 85"+), conceal or channel cables, test inputs |
| **Furniture Assembly** | \$130 – \$240 | Unbox, assemble frame, align drawers/doors, anchor to wall (IKEA, Wayfair, Pottery Barn) |
| **IKEA PAX Wardrobe System** | \$280 – \$550+ | Complex multi-unit wardrobe assembly, sliding door tracks, interior drawers & shelves |
| **Drywall Hole & Crack Patching** | \$150 – \$320 | Spackle, tape, multi-coat mud, sand flush, texture match, and spot paint touch-up |
| **Interior Painting (Per Room)** | \$350 – \$650 | Clean surface prep, patching, trim taping, 2 coats of quality wall paint |
| **Light Fixture / Ceiling Fan Replacement** | \$140 – \$225 | Disconnect existing fixture, test wiring, mount and balance new fixture or fan |
| **Plumbing Fixture Replacement** | \$160 – \$280 | Swap kitchen/bath faucet, replace garbage disposal, or install new toilet & supply lines |
| **Heavy Mirror / Large Art Hanging** | \$140 – \$210 | Laser level alignment, heavy-duty stud or toggle bolt anchor mounting |
| **Trampoline / Playset Assembly** | \$250 – \$450 | Unbox, structural frame assembly, spring tensioning, safety enclosure netting |
| **Minor Repairs / Punch-List Items** | \$120 – \$180 | Adjust sticking doors, replace locksets, caulk tubs, replace switches/plates |

*Note: Custom carpentry, multi-room renovations, and exterior staining are quoted individually with a free in-person or photo estimate.*

## Explicit Service Boundaries & Scope Limits

To ensure quality and compliance, Here Handyman clearly defines what is within scope and what requires specialized trade contractors:

### What Here Handyman Does (In Scope):
- Residential home maintenance, punch-list tasks, and property repairs.
- Fixture-level plumbing (faucets, supply lines, sink traps, toilets, garbage disposals).
- Fixture-level electrical (switches, dimmers, outlets, ceiling fans, light fixtures into existing junction boxes).
- Flat-pack furniture, trampoline, pergola, and outdoor playset assembly.
- Wall mounting of TVs, soundbars, heavy mirrors, and floating shelves.
- Drywall repair, texture patching, interior painting, and trim carpentry.

### What Here Handyman Does NOT Do (Out of Scope / Explicit Boundaries):
- **Major Electrical**: No main panel replacements, no service upgrades (e.g. 100A to 200A), no new whole-house circuits from the street (requires a licensed master electrician).
- **Major Plumbing & Gas**: No main sewer line excavations, no municipal water service line taps, no natural gas or propane line piping (requires a licensed master plumber).
- **Structural Engineering**: No load-bearing wall removal or foundation structural modifications.
- **Whole-Roof Replacements**: No full roof tear-offs or hot-tar roofing (gutter cleaning and minor trim repairs are supported).
- **HVAC Refrigerant**: No central AC compressor refrigerant charging (requires EPA 608 certification).

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How quickly do you respond?**
Usually within 1–3 hours during business hours. For urgent jobs, call or text (516) 350-0801.

**Is the estimate really free?**
Yes — 100% free with no obligation. You get a clear, firm quote before any work starts.

**Do you offer same-day service?**
Yes, same-day and next-day service is often available depending on schedule.

**What areas do you serve?**
All of Westchester County, NY — White Plains, Scarsdale, Yonkers, Tarrytown, Hartsdale, Harrison, New Rochelle, Greenburgh, Valhalla, Elmsford, Dobbs Ferry, Ardsley and more.

**Do you speak Spanish or Portuguese?**
Yes — we serve customers in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
Cash, check, Zelle, Venmo, and major credit cards.

**How much does a handyman cost in Westchester NY?**
Here Handyman prices most jobs with clear flat-rate per-project pricing (e.g. TV mounting \$150–\$225, furniture assembly \$130–\$240, light fixture replacement \$140–\$225). Contact us by call or text at (516) 350-0801 for a free estimate tailored to your project.
